tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the software categories Saaskly covers, with slugs and how many providers are ranked in each.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Ranked providers in a category with editorial score (0–5), one-line summary, entry price and partner disclosure.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Full review of one provider as Markdown: verdict, pros/cons, month-to-month and annual pricing, spec sheet, disclosure.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison table (Markdown) for a category, optionally limited to given provider slugs.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search providers and articles by keyword (name, summary, title). Returns matches with links and .md mirrors.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Published comparison articles and buying guides, optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One article as Markdown (section = comparisons | guides | reviews | news | opinion).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: A policy/about page as Markdown: editorial-policy (scoring method), ai-transparency, about, advertise, terms, privacy-policy, cookie-policy, contact.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_page" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: A policy/about page as Markdown: editorial-policy (scoring method), ai-transparency, about, advertise, terms, privacy-policy, cookie-policy, contact.
